salesLanguage.headline: NHD-600-E-RX: moves AV around the building using the network
salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when sources and displays are spread out, the customer needs flexible routing, or the system may grow over time.
salesLanguage.customerValue: It turns AV into a more flexible system where content can be routed to different places without redesigning fixed cabling every time.

salesLanguage.salespersonCue: Sell the flexibility and future-proofing, then validate the network design.
talkTrack: It is strongest when the system needs expansion, many endpoints, or routing across distance.
It depends on the network, so switch selection and commissioning matter.
It is not automatically the best option for every multi-display room.
